newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Norilsk rises three percent to $15.50.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Norilsk rises three percent to $15.50.

text.p: Russian metals producer Norilsk Nickel rose three percent at 0845 GMT on Wednesday to $15.50 from $15.00 at Tuesday's closing.

Traders said speculative buying was pushing up the share price, which rose to a peak of $15.95 at 0830 GMT, but could not give a more specific reason for the rise. They also said there was underlying support for the stock.

Norilsk shares plunged about 17 percent on Tuesday when the company said it would seek shareholder approval to double charter capital. Traders said the news of the rights issue had prompted fears of a dilution of share value.
